name: Mr. Mime

attacks.name: Barrier Shove
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent’s next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.

flavor:
The broadness of its hands may be no
coincidence—many scientists believe its palms
became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.
